method: Direct source inspection (find, grep, php artisan route:list). Prior docs/audit/*.json artifacts were treated as evidence, not truth; discrepancies are recorded in section 9.
scope: illuvision/core-backend — Laravel 11, PHP ^8.2, modular monolith, Project 01 (Advertising Marketplace).

classification_legend.CURRENT_FACT: Verified from source code on the measurement date.
classification_legend.INFERENCE: Reasonably inferred from implementation or relationships.
classification_legend.OPEN_DECISION: Cannot be determined from available evidence.

counts.event_classes_note: 33 event classes in app/Support/Events/Notifications plus 1 subscriber (App/Support/Events/NotificationEventSubscriber). There are ZERO listener classes.
counts.foreign_key_definitions_note: 94 via ->constrained(...) plus 2 legacy ->foreign(...) across the 112 migrations. The earlier figure of 91 in this artifact was an undercount; the AGENTS.md figure of 94 is the ->constrained() count alone. Three FK-like columns are NOT constrained: bookings.screen_category_id, booking_screens.screen_category_id, booking_screens.screen_provider_id, asset_coverage_cities.state_id (4 columns).

infrastructure_layer_files.note: Strongest layer in the repository. Every external system is already behind an interface with a Laravel adapter (ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rules 1 and 3).

application_layer.status: Layer is being retired per docs/audit/phase-0.20-final-report.md. Reporting (17) and the use cases (15) are the deliberate exceptions kept behind their own boundary. No new class may be added to app/Application.

form_requests.finding: All five return true from authorize(). Authorization is enforced exclusively by route middleware; Form Requests validate shape only.

api_resources.finding: 6 of 7 are used by controllers. PricingPlanResource appears unused at the HTTP layer. Most controllers return raw Eloquent models instead of Resources.

models.orphan_table: screen_types (id + timestamps only; no model, no code reference anywhere)

support_layer.jobs_directory: app/Support/Jobs DOES NOT EXIST. There are no queued job classes anywhere in the repository.

mail.consequence: NotificationService::sendEmail() always takes the MailContractInterface::queue() branch; the send() branch is unreachable in production.

uri_prefix_split.note: Counted from php artisan route:list --json by the leading 'api' segment of the URI.

route_definition_files.note: Explicit Route:: verb calls. The remaining routes come from resource()/Route::apiResource expansions, so definition calls and route entries are different numbers and must not be summed or compared as if they were.
route_definition_files.correction: An earlier draft of this artifact recorded 'api_php: 365, web_php: 2' as though they were route counts. That was unverifiable and has been replaced with the two independently measured figures above (385 total = 380 api-prefixed + 5 non-api).

route_naming.consequence: Route names are entirely Laravel auto-derived; many custom-action routes have name: null.

notable_anomalies: POST /api/file-upload and /api/video-upload are behind auth:sanctum with NO permission middleware and ZERO validation.
Route::apiResource('gallery') is registered AFTER the auth:sanctum group closes, so POST/PUT/DELETE /api/gallery are unauthenticated.
GET/POST /api/admin/assets/import/* are registered before the auth group and have no middleware at all; /import/confirm performs a transactional bulk write to screens.

preexisting_failures: Tests\Feature\BookingConcurrencyTest — expects 'no longer available'; actual message is '... has only N units available, but M requested.'

external_integrations.notes: SDK (Razorpay\Api\Api) is instantiated only inside the adapter. PaymentGatewayInterface is autowired, not explicitly bound.

6 controllers call the Storage facade directly across 11 call sites (AuthorController, GalleryController, JobApplicationController, ScreenController, ScreenProviderPortalController, SuccessStoryController), plus app/Models/Screen.php:95. An earlier 10-controllers figure in this artifact was a call-site count reported as a file count. See 17-storage-asset-reuse-analysis.md.
GD only. No Intervention Image, no Imagick anywhere in app/.
PhpSpreadsheet imported by a controller — an ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rule 1 edge.
phpword imported by a controller — Rule 1 edge.

creative_current_state.keyword_sweep_result: The words creative, creator, brief, proposal, revision, portfolio, freelance, designer, artist, deliverable, escrow, dispute, kyc, onboarding have ZERO occurrences in app/, routes/, database/ or tests/, except (a) governance/audit prose and (b) the unrelated advertising sense of 'creative' meaning an uploaded ad asset (booking_media).
creative_current_state.conclusion: Creative Marketplace is 100% greenfield. Every capability must be newly built, with shared Marketplace infrastructure reused through contracts.

documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.prior_claim: app/Domain/Creative, app/Services/Creative and app/Repositories/Creative exist and are intentionally empty.
prior_claim_sources: docs/audit/phase-0.20-architecture-conformance-score.json ('All 9 Creative subdomains exist and are intentionally empty')
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.reality: All three directories are absent. find app -type d -empty returns nothing; the repository contains zero empty directories.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.resolution: AGENTS.md section 8 was corrected on 2026-09-26 to state the directories do not exist. The prior audit artifacts remain uncorrected on disk — editing them is out of scope for this read-only audit. Report to the architect.

documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.reality: 73 distinct tables and 96 foreign-key definitions (94 ->constrained() + 2 legacy ->foreign()) derived from the 112 migrations, re-measured 2026-09-26. pricing_peak_rules and pricing_weekend_rules are each created twice (dropIfExists + create in 2026_09_20_000000), so counting Schema::create calls (75) overstates by 2. Three screen_provider_settlements FKs (generated_by, approved_by, paid_by) are declared foreignId()->constrained('users') with no onDelete, defaulting to RESTRICT. Three other FK-like columns are NOT constrained: bookings.screen_category_id, booking_screens.screen_category_id, booking_screens.screen_provider_id, asset_coverage_cities.state_id.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.resolution: OPEN_DECISION — whether to correct the governance baseline. Requires a live SHOW TABLES to close definitively.

documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.prior_claim: PaymentService instantiates new Razorpay\Api\Api directly in its constructor.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.reality: Already refactored. PaymentService injects PaymentGatewayInterface; the SDK is confined to RazorpayPaymentGateway.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.resolution: Stale documentation. No code change needed.

documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.prior_claim: A /webhook/razorpay/payment endpoint exists or is expected; webhook idempotency is a stated requirement.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.reality: No webhook route exists in routes/api.php, routes/web.php or routes/console.php. No RazorpayWebhookController exists. Payment verification is entirely client-initiated through POST /api/payments/razorpay/verify.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.resolution: Material for Creative design. A funded-creative-project flow must NOT assume server-to-server webhook infrastructure exists; building one is new work, not reuse.

documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.reality: 2 failures + 1 warning. The third item is the warning itself.
documentation_vs_reality_discrepancies.resolution: Corrected in this artifact and in the master report.
